newsitem.title: USA: Penske Motorsports sets attendence record.
newsitem.headline: Penske Motorsports sets attendence record.

text.p: Penske Motorsports Inc said its Michigan International Speedway closed the 1996 season -- including the new U.S. 500 IndyCar race on Memorial Day weekend -- with record attendance of 616,510 people.
The GM Goodwrench Service Dealer 400 NASCAR race event August 16-18 drew a three-day crowd of 200,409, the largest since the track opened in 1968.

"The 1996 season was one for the record books and certainly one of our best ever," Penske Motorsports vice president Gene Haskett said. "We added an additional 10,000 seats and sold all of them for each event before the season began."
